search_window.basis: Verified preceding 13:47 PST Food Line heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger. Twelve bounded targeted web queries with a Nov 6-8 discovery/backfill lookback; a source published prior to the hourly checkpoint was not treated as a new finding.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary high-value food-access disruption recall, not the primary nationwide collector; production collection remains authoritative.
target_classes: Loss, closure, fire or disaster affecting a community's sole, only, last, or full-service grocery store
Emergency food distribution canceled or suspended because of storm, flood, fire, power outage or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry/food-bank service closure or major access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences

"last grocery store" closed November 2026 small town
"only full service grocery store" November 2026 closing storm
coverage_notes.search_recency: 2-day for most queries, 7-day for three grocery-store queries; explicit November 2026 terms.

coverage_notes.assessment: No verifiable newly emerging qualifying food-access interruption found since the 13:47 PST verified checkpoint in the four specified miss classes.
coverage_notes.limitations: One direct source returned an access failure; five other checks and all 12 searches succeeded. Source indexing latency and bounded queries prevent exhaustive nationwide coverage. The known restricted Georgia story did not materially reduce effective sampling.
coverage_notes.action_limits: Exactly one private watch-ledger JSON. No approval, publication, ingestion, merge, schedule change or task disablement.
